mirath.subtitle: Distribute the client's portfolio under Quranic inheritance rules.

mirath.explainWifeNoChildren: Wife gets 1/4 when there are no children.

mirath.explainMotherNoChildren: Mother gets 1/3 when there are no children.
mirath.explainResiduary: Residuary share — sons receive double daughters' share.

madkholAi.bannerHeadline: Madkhol AI Trading — built to outperform the S&P 500
madkholAi.bannerSubtext: AI-driven trade suggestions, fully reviewed by you before execution.
madkholAi.heroTitle: Madkhol AI Trading — built to outperform
madkholAi.heroSubtitle: A machine-learning engine that watches the markets continuously and surfaces detailed trade suggestions for you to review and approve.
madkholAi.minInvestmentHint: Madkhol AI begins trading once a client's allocated balance reaches this threshold.
madkholAi.minInvestmentBody: Each client allocated to Madkhol AI Trading must hold at least SAR 10,000 in the AI-managed sleeve before the model places any orders. Below that, suggestions are paused for the client and a notice appears in their portfolio.
madkholAi.step1Desc: Link Madkhol AI to your advisor portal in under a minute — no API keys, no plumbing.
madkholAi.step2Desc: The models run around the clock, scanning indices, equities, and sectors against each client's portfolio.
madkholAi.step3Desc: Every suggestion lands in your review queue. Nothing trades without your explicit sign-off — full control, always.
madkholAi.feature1Desc: XGBoost + LSTM models trained on broad historical data emit buy/sell signals with confidence scores.
madkholAi.feature2Desc: Track Madkhol AI's suggestion performance against the benchmark in real time.
madkholAi.feature3Desc: News, flows, and sentiment data continuously feed the underlying models.
madkholAi.feature4Desc: Suggestions only touch Shariah-compliant assets — the same filter the rest of the portal enforces.
madkholAi.faq1A: Yes. Madkhol AI runs inside our CMA-licensed infrastructure. Client data never leaves our servers.
madkholAi.faq2A: No. Every trade requires your explicit approval. You can ignore or edit any suggestion at any time.
madkholAi.faq3A: Madkhol AI is included in your Madkhol advisor subscription at no extra cost during launch.
madkholAi.faq4A: Yes. The same Shariah filter applied across the portal is enforced on every AI suggestion.
madkholAi.faq5A: Yes — one click from your connection settings.
madkholAi.bottomCta: Activate now — setup takes a minute.
madkholAi.modalStep1Body: By agreeing, you confirm that you've read and accepted the Madkhol AI usage terms and privacy policy. Auto-execution is opt-in only.
madkholAi.modalLevel1Desc: The models send trade ideas; you approve each one before any execution.
madkholAi.modalLevel2Desc: Small trades execute automatically when available — rolling out in a future phase.
madkholAi.modalStep3Body: You're all set. Once confirmed, Madkhol AI starts analyzing your clients' portfolios and your first suggestions will appear within 24 hours.
madkholAi.modalSuccessBody: Your first Madkhol AI suggestions will appear in your dashboard within 24 hours. Track them from the Madkhol AI tab in the sidebar.
madkholAi.suggestionsSubtitle: AI-generated trade ideas. Review each, then decide.
